notes.title: 1.04 Update
notes.content:
[b][All Versions][/b]
[list]
[*] Portals are now exciting new shapes to make them more distinct and to help colorblind players.
[*]Scene skips happen faster.
[/list]
[b][Windows][/b]
[list]
[*]Added Xbox 360 Controller support.
[*]Updated tutorials and menus to reflect keyboard or controller use.
[/list]
That's it [i]for now.[/i]

[i]Note: The high score name input method has been changed to require holding the up or down button for about half a second to begin cycling through the alphabet. A small update is coming soon to accommodate the old behavior as well.[/i]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Trace Vector, 15% off!
notes.content:
Trace Vector is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

Trace Vector is a modern take on tough as nails, high speed, vector, action arcade games from the 1980's. Turn up the music, navigate your ship through high speed warp networks, maintain your fuel reserves, avoid deadly hazards, and try to safely return home!



Quarters not required.

*Offer ends August 26 at 10AM Pacific Time
